svg.title: Event-driven brain X-ray analysis architecture
svg.desc: Browser uploads X-ray to API gateway, which publishes to Kafka broker, which fans out to ML inference, image processing, and LangChain chatbot services. Results aggregate and push back to the client via WebSocket.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How should the user-facing dashboard be designed for this brain X-ray system?')
sendPrompt('What are the API gateway responsibilities in this event-driven X-ray system?')
sendPrompt('Which Kafka topics should I define for this brain X-ray system?')
g.text: Decoupled pub/sub · async fan-out · durable topics

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does the ML inference service integrate with FastAPI and return prediction results?')
sendPrompt('What image processing pipeline should I build — heatmap, intensity slicing, and novel filters?')
sendPrompt('How do I wire up the LangChain chatbot to be context-aware of the X-ray results?')
sendPrompt('How should the result aggregator merge ML, image processing, and chatbot outputs for the dashboard?')
g.text: Collects events · composes payload · pushes to dashboard
